title: docs(qa): v18.5.0 sweep runner kit — qa-fixture --help and oidc-stub, RUNNER.md runner facts
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-steve"} -->
_Requested by **Steve** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01FdL1XeUyvVNxLreh3F4Qi9?thread=cmsg_01FdL1XeUyvVNxLreh3F4Qi9Hh6t1t7VgnERX7Sim47B9F)_

Fixes #33968
Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读

- 改了什么：跑手工具两处——`qa-fixture.mjs` 的 `--help` 不再误跑夹具，新增本地 OIDC 身份提供方夹具 `oidc-stub`;RUNNER.md 补六条跑手环境事实(逐条实测)。
- 为什么改：18.5.0 发版测试账本里 8 行属于跑手工具，跑手每轮重复踩坑或被迫手搭 OIDC 桩。
- 风险与回滚：只动 QA 文档和仓内 QA 脚本，不发布、不进产品包;回滚即 revert 本 PR。
- 先看:`scripts/qa/qa-fixture.mjs`(help 分支与 oidc-stub 段),`docs/qa/platform-checklist/RUNNER.md`(新增条目)。
- 两分钟验证:`node scripts/qa/qa-fixture.mjs broken-upstream-app --help; echo $?` 应只打印用法、退出 0,`/tmp` 下不出现新的 `qa-broken-upstream-*` 目录。
- 需要你做的：无，席位落地。

## What changes

The runner-kit rows of the v18.5.0 sweep ledger (anchor #33761, ledger comment 6896511848), each re-read at `origin/main` `895783a1` and measured on this branch.

| Ledger row | What it said | What changed |
|---|---|---|
| 7 | `qa-fixture.mjs FIXTURE --help` runs the fixture | A help request anywhere on the line (`--help`, `-h`, or the `help` command) prints the synopsis and common flags, read from the script's own header so the two cannot drift, and exits 0 with nothing run. It is read off the raw arguments before `parseArgs`. |
| 10 | per-file summary line needs `--reporter=verbose` | Measured otherwise: in a non-TTY shell `verbose` prints one line per test and still no file line; `--reporter=tree` prints `✓ … src/env.test.ts (63 tests)`. RUNNER.md says `--reporter=tree`, with the three readings. |
| 22 | installed-local removal answers 422; restart with the cached manifest moved aside | RUNNER.md: `DELETE /api/v1/packages/ID` answers 422 `WRITABLE_PACKAGE_REQUIRED`, and `DELETE /api/v1/marketplace/install-local/MANIFEST_ID` removes it at once with no restart (measured), with its 409 cases read from the door's header. |
| 91 | registry recipe facts belong in RUNNER.md | New entry: the npmjs uplink trusts the egress proxy only through the shell's `NODE_OPTIONS` / `SSL_CERT_FILE` (a cleared environment answers 404 "no such package available"), the user door `PUT /-/user/org.couchdb.user:NAME`, and `max_body_size` (12 MB tarball: E413 at default, published at 100mb). |
| 103 | promote the local OIDC stub to a `scripts/qa` fixture | New `qa-fixture.mjs oidc-stub`: discovery + per-run JWKS on `localhost` from a detached process `teardown` stops; `--register` registers it as the admin and reads it back. RUNNER.md entry added. |
| 192 | `os dev` takes the next free port silently | It is not silent (both shift lines print, already in RUNNER.md); added the trap the reading names: a "restart" while the old server listens is a second server on the next port against the same file DB (measured). |
| 202 | `pnpm --dir APP exec … 'qa/*.test.json'` resolves inside APP | New entry with the measurement: the pnpm line ran the showcase's suite; the binary by full path, or an absolute glob, ran the staged suite. |
| 215 | `npm publish tarballs/x.tgz` needs `./` | In the registry entry: without `./` npm 10.9.9 runs `git ls-remote ssh://git@github.com/tarballs/…` and exits 128; with `./` it publishes. |

## Tests

`qa-fixture.mjs` has no self-test, so none was extended; no test file changed. The readings below are the evidence.

<details><summary>--help, before and after</summary>

Before, at `895783a1`:

```
$ node scripts/qa/qa-fixture.mjs broken-upstream-app --help
qa-fixture: copying examples/app-showcase to /tmp/qa-broken-upstream-qbLcb7/app (no node_modules, no build output)
{ "fixture": "broken-upstream-app", … }        exit 0  (the fixture ran; torn down after)
$ node scripts/qa/qa-fixture.mjs --help
qa-fixture: REFUSED — unknown fixture "--help": one of …        exit 2
```

After, at `6ee7aa00`: `broken-upstream-app --help`, `--help`, `-h`, `help`, `walled-boot --port 1 --help` and `teardown -h` each exit 0 with the 14-line usage on stdout, nothing on stderr, and no new `/tmp/qa-broken-upstream-*` directory. A bare call with no fixture still refuses, exit 2.

</details>

<details><summary>oidc-stub, live</summary>

- Standalone: exit 0; discovery and JWKS answered; `teardown --dir DIR` stopped the recorded process group and a request to the stub then got no answer.
- `os dev` showcase boot on 41900 with `OS_SSO_ENABLED=true` (its `OS_TRUSTED_ORIGINS` named another stub port): `oidc-stub --register --base-url http://localhost:41900 --groups-claim groups` exit 0, read back `groupsClaim: groups`.
- Control, `os dev` boot on 41910 with `OS_SSO_ENABLED=true` and no `OS_TRUSTED_ORIGINS`: `--register` exit 0. The `isDev` default in `packages/cli/src/commands/serve.ts` trusts `http://localhost:*`, so the fixture prints `OS_TRUSTED_ORIGINS` only for a boot outside `os dev` (that refusal read from source, not booted).
- Boot without `OS_SSO_ENABLED`: the register door answered 404 `SSO_REGISTER_FAILED`.

</details>

## Acceptance notes

- Row 10's suggested flag was `--reporter=verbose`; the reading shows it gives no per-file line, so RUNNER.md names `--reporter=tree`. The ~50 item clauses that ask for "the summary line per pin file" are item text, left to the batch cards.
- The SSO items' `fixtures.requires[0]` says a local IdP origin must be in `OS_TRUSTED_ORIGINS`; on an `os dev` boot it need not be (measured above). Item text, left to the batch cards.
- The stub serves no sign-in (authorize, token and userinfo answer 501), so a clause needing a federated sign-in is still not driven by it; RUNNER.md says so.
- The branch is behind `origin/main` by commits that touch neither changed file.

## Verification

<details><summary>Gates at 6ee7aa00</summary>

`node scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs --commands --repo objectstack-ai/objectstack` derived 32 families; each ran with stdin from `/dev/null` and exited 0. `--ran` reconciliation: 32 derived, 32 run, 0 NOT-MEASURED, 0 UNRUN. Full `pnpm build --concurrency=2` under the verify lock: VERDICT command-exit 0, 119 tasks.

</details>
